title: PurdueGlobal vs WGU: control, tuition, size
summary: Purdue University Global (PurdueGlobal) versus Western Governors University (WGU). Also searched as WGU vs PurdueGlobal. Scorecard table is sourced; prose is checked against those facts. UniRepository is not affiliated with either school.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: When comparing the cost of attendance, Purdue University Global (PurdueGlobal) and Western Governors University (WGU) show notable differences. PurdueGlobal's in-state tuition is $10,101, while WGU charges $8,658 for both in-state and out-of-state students. For out-of-state tuition, PurdueGlobal's rate is $14,412, significantly higher than WGU's flat rate of $8,658. Regarding student debt, the median debt for PurdueGlobal completers is $26,078, more than double WGU's median debt of $11,116. These figures highlight the cost disparities between the two institutions, with WGU offering a more uniform tuition rate and lower median debt among graduates. Thus, PurdueGlobal vs WGU comparisons reveal differences in tuition structure and financial outcomes for students.
